instruction: `TypeAdapter.write(JsonWriter out, T value)` (com.google.gson) takes its arguments in the opposite order of `toJson(T value)`/`toJsonTree(T value)` and shares its name with `java.io.Writer.write`, which makes adapter code hard to search. Rename it to `writeValue` and put the value first: the abstract method becomes `public abstract void writeValue(T value, JsonWriter out) throws IOException`. Change every `TypeAdapter` subclass that overrides it -- named, nested and anonymous `new TypeAdapter<...>() { ... }` classes, in every Maven module (gson, extras, proto, metrics, test-graal-native-image, test-shrinker, test-jpms) and in tests -- to `writeValue(<value parameter>, <JsonWriter parameter>)`, keeping each override's parameter names, modifiers and body. Update every call of `TypeAdapter.write` (through fields, locals, `delegate()`, `TypeAdapter.this`, unqualified calls inside adapters, ...) to `writeValue` with the two argument expressions swapped. Do not touch methods that merely look similar: `java.io.Writer.write`, `Streams.write(JsonElement, JsonWriter)`, and `ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.BoundField.write(JsonWriter, Object)` (and its implementations and calls) keep their names and parameter order. Do not keep a `write` method or a forwarding overload on `TypeAdapter`. Behavior must not change.
gold_tool: deephard_recipes_java.py: every `void write(JsonWriter, X)` declaration (BoundField's, which throws IllegalAccessException, excluded) renamed + parameters swapped in masked text; calls from javac's own `cannot find symbol ... write(JsonWriter,...)` errors, renamed + arguments swapped; docker maven test-compile clean (-pl !test-jpms, which needs the packaged jar)
change: rename + parameter swap of the core abstract method TypeAdapter.write(JsonWriter, T) -> writeValue(T, JsonWriter): every override (mostly anonymous classes, 5 Maven modules) and every call; same-named BoundField.write / Writer.write / Streams.write stay
notes: Look-alikes with the same name and arity (BoundField.write(writer, source), Streams.write(element, writer)) are unchanged by gold, so they cancel in the write/2 counts. gold renamed 129 declarations and 46 calls.
